prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: unlit physically based game texture source atlas, not a photograph of objects.
Make a square image filled edge to edge by exactly FOUR equal-height horizontal strips of old heavy structural timber surface. Each strip is one different long face, wood grain running left-to-right. No gaps, black lines, edge bevels, framing, text, nails, screws, end grain or perspective. We will crop interiors, so fill each strip with uninterrupted grain. Timber in an early hand-built proper house, oak and dense old-growth softwood, rich dark warm brown, oiled long ago, about sRGB 104 72 48. VERY fine dense realistic fibres and subtle long flowing growth lines. First strip: quietly hand-hewn dark oak with broad shallow irregular adze scallops and restrained dense grain, no knots. Second: pit-sawn warm umber oak with tiny faint straight cross-grain saw scratches, mostly long straight grain, no knot. Third: worn axe-squared chestnut-brown timber, mildly undulating grain and one small quiet pin knot. Fourth: pit-sawn aged russet-brown dense softwood, tight long fibre bundles, no knot. No big cracks or holes (they are added as actual geometry separately).
Each strip depicts about 1.8 metres length and 45 centimetres height, extremely crisp close-range texture. Every strip different grain topology. Subdued moderate colour variation, no strong pale sapwood. Strictly diffuse base colour under perfectly uniform cross-polarized illumination: NO specular highlights, NO directional light, NO ambient occlusion, NO cast shadows, NO dark strip edges, NO gradient or vignette. Restrained natural pigment differences are the detail. Native photographic microtexture, no stylized wavy stripes, no painterly appearance. 2048x2048 requested.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: flat unlit heavy oak game texture source.
Square image, precisely FOUR horizontal wood strips each quarter image height. Grain always horizontal left-to-right. These are full-bleed texture swatches, no view of beam edges or ends. Each is a DIFFERENT heavy timber, uniformly dark warm brown, modest pigment contrast. Top strip aged pit-sawn oak: fine dense mostly straight grain, nearly imperceptible perpendicular saw scratches, no knot. Second strip old adze-squared oak: broad shallow oval hewing scallops, undulating grain, no knot. Third strip weathered worn umber oak: dense slightly open fibres, subdued old silvering but still warm brown, ONE tiny oval knot toward left. Bottom strip sawn dense old-growth softwood: warm dark walnut brown, long fine parallel irregular grain, no knot.
Very crisp physically believable wood fibres, close texture of antique structural beams, not modern walnut veneer. Each strip covers approx 180 cm by 45 cm. Tight restrained grain, no huge looping cathedral patterns. Exact overhead orthographic surface sampling, perfectly diffuse cross-polarized UNLIT albedo with no directional illumination, no shadows or highlights, no dark edges, no gaps between strips, no gradient, no iron, no nails, no holes, no big cracks, no text. Target average sRGB 104,72,48. 2048 square.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: unlit game material source atlas.
A square filled by exactly FOUR equal-height horizontal strips of dark heavy structural oak wood. Every strip one distinct antique beam long-face texture. No background, no gaps, no black joints, no borders, no bevel, no perspective, no endgrain. Horizontal grain throughout. Each 180cm by 45cm.
Strip 1 (top): rich deep earth-brown hand-hewn timber, broad irregular shallow axe scoops, organic gently wavering tight grain, a very small quiet knot near right third.
Strip 2: aged pit-sawn oak with long quiet straight dense grain, tobacco umber brown; faint very fine across-grain sawing traces.
Strip 3: warm brown worn weathered hand-squared softwood, subtle diffuse brown/grey pigment drift, dense long thin fibres, no knot.
Strip 4: old weathered oak timber, deep sienna and umber, worn subdued hewing, coarse and fine fibres intermingled, no knot.
Keep the grain fine, irregular and convincing at close range. Timber has been oiled and aged but is dry to touch. Restrained realistic variation, darker than honey-brown wall boards. All texture must be base colour: perfectly uniform diffuse cross-polarized illumination, NO baked light or shadow, NO specular glints, NO occlusion, NO overall brightness gradient, no vignetting. No huge cracks, no holes, no metal, no lettering. Crisp native texture. 2048x2048.
